meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按步骤把 clidash 复制到 tools 目录、生成配置文件、运行测试并启动一个只读 web 仪表盘。该仪表盘从 ncl CLI 读取资源并显示为标签页和表格，附带活动图表、日志尾部和文件查看器。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 clidash 仪表盘，或要求安装这个只读面板时触发。
